workPending: Sharing preferences need a result check
unchanged: No changes from the confirmed sharing preferences
failed: Sharing preferences could not be saved
conflict: Review the current sharing preferences before saving
localHint: These indicators cover your sharing choices and recorder label for the selected family. Changes stay on this screen during this login. Refreshing or leaving may lose them. Other family actions use their own controls.
unconfirmed: The sharing save result is not confirmed
checkFailed: Your sharing preferences could not be checked
different: Current preferences differ from the submitted version
pendingHint: Your inputs stay here. Check the account before changing families or saving again. This check only reads preferences; it never repeats the save. An earlier request may still finish later.
useCheckedConfirm: Replace your inputs with the preferences just checked, including their sharing choices? This does not send a new save or cancel the earlier request. That request may still finish later; review the account again before relying on these values.
stopConfirm: Stop tracking this uncertain result and discard these inputs? This does not cancel a save already sent. It may still change sharing. Check the family's saved preferences again before relying on them.
discardConfirm: Restore the last confirmed sharing choices and recorder label? This only restores your inputs; it does not send a save or change sharing on the account.
leaveDiscard: Your unsaved sharing preferences will also be discarded.
